description: This file defines a C++ interface class 'IEventHandler' within the 'WPEFramework::Plugin' namespace. The class declares four pure virtual methods intended for handling different OCI container events, each accepting a container name and JSON data.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface for handling OCI container events, including start, stop, failure, and state change events.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Handles container start events; takes container name and JSON data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Handles container stop events; takes container name and JSON data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Handles container failure events; takes container name and JSON data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles container state change events; takes container name and JSON data.
